title: Retaliation of the Waste
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's humiliating defeat, kneeling and begging for mercy, the Sect Master's face dark— the landscape of Tianqing Sect is about to be completely rewritten by this battle.

text.content: Sword light like an inverted Milky Way, carrying the power to destroy heaven and earth, directly targeting Chen Ji's throat. Ling Yuan's hair stood on end, eyes filled with ruthless determination to win— he had waited for this moment too long, each breath feeling like torment. 'A waste should die like a waste!' His roar made the watching disciples' eardrums ache, the blue stone beneath his feet was blown away by the air wave, revealing the dark brown earth underneath.

Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at the approaching sword light, when his lips suddenly curved slightly upward. That smile was as faint as a fleeting cold mist over a winter lake, yet it made Ling Yuan inexplicably uneasy— that feeling, like a hunter near a trap suddenly catching the scent of a fierce beast. In the next instant, Chen Ji moved.

dialogue.content: Senior Ling, your strike missed by three inches.

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji slightly tilted his body, perfectly evading the sword's most fierce point. His pace was hauntingly precise, as if he had memorized the sword's trajectory in advance. Each step he took landed squarely in the gaps of Ling Yuan's attacks. Despite being in a life-and-death confrontation, Chen Ji's movements remained remarkably composed, leisurely strolling through his own courtyard, even taking a moment to casually adjust his wind-tousled sleeves.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan launched seven consecutive attacks, each one landing nowhere. His expression turned ashen. Chen Ji had completely deciphered his sword technique— now the question remained: how would he choose to end this match?

dialogue.content: Senior Ling, you are too slow.

choices.description: Don't rush to act, first use words to shatter Ling Yuan's mental defenses, letting him collapse on his own
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's mindset shatters, fighting spirit entirely gone

dialogue.content: Senior Ling, do you know why the Heavenly Secrets Record did not choose you?

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression changed dramatically. He recognized the sword technique Chen Ji was currently施展— it was clearly the 'Stone-Cracking Slash' he had stolen from Xuanwu Sect thirty years ago, a supreme technique never shown before others. How could he... how could he possibly know? Cold sweat slid down his spine, and for the first time, Ling Yuan felt bone-deep fear.

dialogue.content: You... how did you learn this technique! This is from Xuanwu Sect...

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, merely transitioning his sword stance, directly slashing toward Ling Yuan with the seventh form of 'Stone-Cracking Slash'— the most powerful and hardest to defend against move, unchanged. The sword light tearing through the air was sharp and ear-piercing, like countless souls wailing. Ling Yuan frantically raised his sword to block, yet discovered he simply could not keep up with the technique's changing rhythm.

In a thunderous crash, Ling Yuan was knocked back ten steps, his tiger's mouth cracked open, blood staining half the sword hilt. Dead silence surrounded them. The watching inner disciples stared wide-eyed, gazing at the unbelievable scene before them— a堂堂 Tianqing Sect Elder, actually defeated by a servant disciple using his own sword technique?

Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, each footfall seeming to trample on Ling Yuan's heart. His gaze was terrifyingly calm— no anger, no mockery, only an almost cold scrutiny. 'Senior Ling, the things you did at Xuanwu Sect thirty years ago, shall this junior help you recall?' His voice was not loud, yet it made Ling Yuan's whole body tremble.

choices.description: Defeat but do not completely destroy, give Ling Yuan a chance to repent, also preserve a good reputation for oneself

dialogue.content: Senior Ling, you have lost. Today's matter ends here.

text.content: Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply. Holy Sect? How could Chen Ji know about the Holy Sect? That was a secret he had buried for twenty years, the most taboo topic in his midnight dreams. He opened his mouth, wanting to deny, yet discovered his voice was strangled by something. Fear like a tide engulfed him.

At this moment, a sharp gaze shot from the crowd. Su Qingyao stood not far away, her beautiful eyes flickering with complex light. She stared at Chen Ji's back, her heart churning with giant waves— this man she had been secretly investigating was indeed unfathomable. But for some reason, a trace of... relief? actually rose in her heart.

Ling Yuan finally collapsed. He knelt on the ground, trembling all over, his former prestige completely gone. 'I... I admit defeat...' His voice was hoarse and humble, no longer the domineering elder from moments ago. The surrounding crowd erupted in outrage— a Tianqing Sect elder actually begging for mercy from a servant disciple? This scene would be forever etched in everyone's memory.

Chen Ji looked down at Ling Yuan kneeling below, his expression cold as frost. 'Senior Ling, you just said a waste should die like a waste.' His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached each person's ears, 'This junior thinks waste is not scary, what is scary is being a waste yet pretending to be a prodigy.'

dialogue.content: You... what exactly are you? Why would the Heavenly Secrets Record choose a waste like you!

text.content: Chen Ji heard this, his lips curving into a meaningful arc. He slowly turned around, walking toward the arena exit under the crowd's reverent gaze, his silhouette lonely yet composed. 'Who the Heavenly Secrets Record chooses is not decided by me, nor by you, Senior Ling.' His voice gradually faded, carrying an inexplicable sense of regret, 'Senior Ling, you never lost to me, but to heaven's will.'

The news of Ling Yuan's humiliating defeat spread like wildfire throughout Tianqing Sect in just one hour. Some were shocked, some suspicious, more found it unbelievable— that servant disciple called waste actually defeated a堂堂 elder? And in the Sect Master's hall, a gloomy gaze was watching the distance— that was Ling Yuan's true backing... or rather, the backing he thought he had.
